'''Taiwanese beef noodle soup''' ({{zh|t=臺灣牛肉麵}}) is a [[beef noodle soup]] dish that originated in [[Taiwan]]. It is sometimes referred to as "Sichuanese beef noodle soup" ({{zh|t=四川牛肉麵}}) in Taiwan, although this usage can create confusion as [[Sichuan]] has its own versions of beef noodle soups,<ref>{{Cite book|last=Lin|first=Florence|title=Florence Lin's Complete book of Chinese noodles, dumplings and breads|date=1986|others=Peter LaVigna|isbn=0-688-03796-8|edition=|location=New York|pages=43|oclc=12978274}}</ref> which may be sold at Sichuanese restaurants under the same name.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2017-01-27|title=Sichuan noodles at sixty-one SFBA Sichuan restaurants|url=https://www.hungryonion.org/t/sichuan-noodles-at-sixty-one-sfba-sichuan-restaurants/8120|access-date=2021-07-02|website=Hungry Onion|language=en-US}}</ref>
